verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping and tax SaaS service that handles sensitive financial data, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where data is stored; the security page covers only Plaid account connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
